model_sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.ProductID,
        p.ProductName,
        p.Category,
        SUM(l.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'Products') }} p
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'Sales_OrderLines') }} l
        ON l.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.ProductName, p.Category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ProductID,
        ProductName,
        Category,
        UnitsSold,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC, ProductID) AS overall_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lower(rtrim(Category))
            ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC, ProductID
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM sales
)
SELECT
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    Category,
    UnitsSold,
    overall_rank,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
param_filter: (@Category IS NULL AND overall_rank <= @TopN) OR (lower(rtrim(Category)) = lower(rtrim(@Category)) AND category_rank <= @TopN)

explanation: This procedure ranks products by total units sold across all order lines and returns the top N, optionally limited to one product category. Products are ordered by units sold (highest first, ties broken by ProductID). When a category is supplied, the ranking is done only among products in that category.
